items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: I’m not on Sonny Rollins’ sort of level of quotes

ctx.x: I wanted to make a comment that I was watching a video of you and a big band and you were playing “I Wish I Knew.” And you were playing your curved soprano and I just wanted you to know that your quote in your solo of “Honeysuckle Rose” was noticed.
Well that’s good, yes. I mean sometimes — well I mean quotes are sort of — I’m not on Sonny Rollins’ sort of level of quotes, but —
But it’s an interesting process because you have to realize how do I fit this particular tune into this particular key? Right? It’s a mental gymnastics sort of thing.
